full_judgment: 4. Kh Mahbub Hossain, the learned Advocate appearing for the petitioner has made submission to the effect that the petitioner is all along in Bangladesh and he was a government servant till 14-01-92 and at present also he has been drawing his pension regularly and that all the papers including the lease deed, mutated Khatian Loan sanction letter, rent receipts, tax receipts, electricity bills, etc. submitted by the petitioners in the annexures to the writ petition very well prove petitioners title and also continuous possession in the building in question. The learned Advocate has submitted that the petitioners buildings can not be treated as abandoned property as defined in President's Order 16 of 1972.
